acceptanceCriteria: The release-manifest.json residual-file failure is reproduced before implementation.
Success and manifest-failure paths remove the isolated download directory after artifacts are captured.
Cleanup failure is explicitly recorded and causes a fail-closed result without changing release truth.
Regression tests cover isolated TMPDIR and fake gh behavior for success and manifest-failure cleanup.
No out-of-scope files are modified and the script remains compatible with shellcheck and repository release checks.
goal: Make release version consistency success and manifest-failure paths clean their isolated download directory without hiding cleanup failures or mutating release truth.
intent: Prevent release version consistency harness cleanup failures caused by residual release-manifest.json and preserve release truth when cleanup fails.
outOfScope: all runtime crates; other release harnesses; release metadata; global Agent or MCP configuration; unrelated Work Items

scenarioCoverage.expected: A successful public Release check captures its receipt and removes the isolated download directory.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the version consistency script with a fake gh command and an isolated mktemp implementation, then assert the run root is empty.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A malformed or mismatched release manifest fails closed, captures the failure, and removes the isolated download directory.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the post-release script with a fake gh manifest that fails validation and assert cleanup and failure truth.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A cleanup failure is recorded explicitly and never rewrites release publication truth.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject a cleanup failure in the isolated test harness and assert the receipt preserves releasePublished=true while reporting cleanup failure.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The regression uses isolated temporary roots and a fake gh provider without network or source fallback.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: isolated TMPDIR and fake gh boundary
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused shell regression with fake gh and assert all temporary roots are accounted for and cleaned.
